confidence_notes: City-level price indexes provide a useful basis for meals, cappuccino and draft beer, though reported USD prices vary. Cocktail and wine are estimated from their relationship to local restaurant beer prices; accommodation is a holistic estimate and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Nuwara Eliya-specific cost indexes. Accommodation estimates use general knowledge of Sri Lanka's hill-country tourist towns, adjusted for Nuwara Eliya's visitor demand.
